## Context / Problem

`scripts/gen_api_surface.py:92-155` serializes parameter descriptors but omits return annotations although `docs/api-stability.md:24` includes return `TypedDict`s in the stable subset. A return-only contract regression currently leaves the baseline unchanged. This applies to both top-level public callables and public methods of captured rebar-owned classes: `_describe_class` presently emits each method as a bare parameter list, so return capture needs an intentional compatible baseline-shape migration.

## Approach

Introduce one internal return-normalization helper. It emits JSON `null` only for `inspect.Signature.empty`; an actual `None` annotation remains the stable string `"None"`. It preserves postponed string annotations verbatim and uses `inspect.formatannotation` for live annotation objects, producing a JSON string without `repr`-quoting string annotations. Exercise representative string and live-object annotations so the normalized output is deterministic across supported Python versions.

Use the helper for every introspectable top-level callable and every public class method currently captured by `_describe_class`. Migrate each class-method baseline entry from its bare parameter list to `{"params": [...], "return": <normalized string-or-null>}`; top-level callable descriptors gain the same `"return"` field beside `"params"`. A non-introspectable callable remains represented as today with `params: null` and `return: null`, rather than inventing a return annotation. Regenerate the committed baseline and add held-out return-only drift cases for one top-level callable and one captured public class method. Do not expand `MODULES` or the documented public surface.

## Scope

- `scripts/gen_api_surface.py`
- `tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json`
- API-surface gate tests and public-types contract tests

## Testing

Cover `Signature.empty` (`null`), actual `None` (`"None"`), postponed string annotations, and a live typing/type annotation through the shared normalizer. Cover return-only drift for both a top-level callable and a captured class method while their parameter descriptors remain identical. Run the generator check and focused API checks on every supported Python version.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Each introspectable top-level public callable descriptor contains `"return"`, set to a normalized annotation string or JSON `null` only when its return annotation is `Signature.empty`.
- [x] Each public class method already captured by `_describe_class` is migrated from a bare parameter list to a descriptor with unchanged `"params"` and the same normalized `"return"` field; no method outside the existing captured-method rule is added.
- [x] The normalizer preserves postponed string annotations without `repr` quoting, formats live annotation objects with `inspect.formatannotation`, represents an actual `None` annotation as `"None"`, and represents `Signature.empty` as JSON `null`.
- [x] Existing parameter serialization remains unchanged; the regenerated baseline differs only by the deliberate return fields and class-method list-to-descriptor migration.
- [x] A parameter-identical, return-only change fails the held-out drift test for both a top-level public callable and a captured public class method.
- [x] The focused generator/API-contract checks and supported-Python matrix pass deterministically.
